source_registry.source_note: Official Menagerie closure is vendored under demo2/legacy_assets/menagerie/leap_hand.

protocol_note: The 0.02 rad max-absolute-error and 0.5 s dwell are human-approved Demo2 research criteria, not manufacturer performance claims.

tasks.description: Move the left LEAP Hand to the specified neutral joint posture and hold it.
tasks.criterion_summary: All selected joints remain within 0.02 rad max absolute error for 0.5 s under the Demo2 research protocol.

tasks.description: Flex the index finger to the specified posture and hold it.
tasks.criterion_summary: The index joints remain within 0.02 rad max absolute error for 0.5 s under the Demo2 research protocol.

tasks.description: Move the middle and ring fingers to matched specified postures and hold the symmetry.
tasks.criterion_summary: Each paired middle/ring joint remains within 0.02 rad symmetry error for 0.5 s under the Demo2 research protocol.

tasks.description: Move the thumb to the specified opposition posture and hold it.
tasks.criterion_summary: The thumb joints remain within 0.02 rad max absolute error for 0.5 s under the Demo2 research protocol.

tasks.description: Close the fingers through a bounded joint motion and finish in a minimal pre-grasp posture.
tasks.criterion_summary: All selected pre-grasp joints remain within 0.02 rad max absolute error for 0.5 s under the Demo2 research protocol; no object or contact claim is made.
